main_text.p: reliquis casibus χρέως, ut Chœrobosco ait) item à πλέως plenus: ut ἀνώγεων cœnaculum, quasi ἀνὼ τῆς γῆς ὂν supra terram eminens, communiter ἀνώγαιον.
ὁ ἡ Λυτρογήγεως macrum solum habens.
ὁ ἡ ὕγπρως facilé senectutem ferens.
ὁ ἡ ἀνάπλεως, ἔκπλεως, ἐχρεως, plenus, plena. sed ρως & λως communiter flectuntur per ωτος.

page.notes: Greek headwords are partly damaged and accents are uncertain in several places; the Greek forms are transcribed as far as legible and may contain errors. Several lines show faint show-through.
